1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing __genotyping__ of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) __after step (c),__ germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __without extracting the DNA__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without extracting the DNA__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __VISCOZYME® as__ an enzyme.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __of corn__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __in stasis storage to achieve a quiescent condition__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: __single nucleotide polymorphism detection__ [[single nucleotide polymorphism detection,]] restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __for a trait associated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __determined from the shed cellular material collected from the one or more embryos while retaining viability of the selected one or more embryos__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated.
